verdict.rationale: An in-browser dev toolbar is a reasonable thing to ask of a web hosting and deployment platform, so the axis applies, but the evidence pack never mentions a toolbar for leaving feedback, managing feature flags, or inspecting performance on a live site. The nearby items do not count as this capability: Deploy Previews, a shared preview environment, and per-deploy performance tracking are related features but not a toolbar on the live site.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use an in-browser toolbar to leave feedback, manage feature flags, and inspect performance directly on my live site
